entities.summary: Hugo, Prince of Radolin, born Hugo Julius Raoul Eduard Graf Leszczyc von Radolin-Radolinski, was a German aristocrat of Polish descent, statesman who served as an ambassador for the Kingdom of Prussia and later, the German Empire, as well as a high-ranking official in the royal and imperial courts.
